# WaiKwan (waikwantent.com)

Guangxi WaiKwan Tent Manufacturing Co., Ltd. is a B2B factory-direct manufacturer of custom outdoor and exhibition display products. The site supports OEM, ODM, and export programs for distributors, event companies, print shops, and resellers.

## Product focus
- Custom canopy tents
- Pop up canopy tents
- Beach flags and poles
- Portable display systems
- SEG light boxes

## Canonical site
https://www.waikwantent.com/
